facts.business: Corporate Merchant Bankers Limited is a listed company engaged in merchant banking activities.

auditor.name: M/s. D D S & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Ahmedabad
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Cash payments of ₹24.00 lakhs towards salary expenses without sufficient audit evidence; 2) Tax deducted at source on professional fees and interest expenses remaining unpaid to government authorities as at 31 March 2026; 3) Unsecured borrowings aggregating ₹8,187.74 lakhs from various parties with no interest provided, lack of loan agreements/confirmations, and ₹6,010.41 lakhs converted into equity share capital.

key_risks: Cash payments towards salary expenses without proper documentation
Unpaid tax deducted at source liabilities
Unsecured borrowings without interest provision and proper documentation
Non-compliance with certain listing regulations and delayed filings
